highlands_knoll.idea: A small round knoll inside a ring of cairns under a cluster of peaks, its top held from the start. A short walk, every way uphill, and nowhere far from the top.

highlands_moor.idea: An open moor of heather on a long slope, round one massif of bare peaks, with a clan's banners and cairns on the way. The fight goes round it either side, through heather for cover.

highlands_scarp.idea: Stacked rock fills the north-west corner, and the slope climbs to a shelf of grass and bare rock under it. A cluster of peaks to get behind on the way up.

hills_crags.idea: Up a long slope between two massifs of peaks set on the slant, an S to walk through dark pines, to a brow across the top.

hills_saddle.idea: Two massifs of sharp peaks close in on a saddle. The only straight way runs up between them, past dark pines; the long ways go round each massif's outer side.

hills_shoulder.idea: A long grassy shoulder rising to the north-west, a gully falling away on the north-east, between two great clusters of peaks. Dark pines stand on the slope; the massif in the west splits the climb, so it means picking a side first.

monastery_heights_climb.idea: A stone path zigzags up the whole hillside between low walls, in stone steps where it climbs, under peaks at the top. The path is the quick way; the slope either side is open but slower going, and the top is held.

monastery_heights_gardens.idea: A slope climbing to an open terrace at the north under a cluster of peaks, herb gardens in staggered rows on the way, and two low walls closing in toward the middle. The gardens block: walk the rows or go through the gap.

monastery_heights_ridge.idea: A massif of peaks beside a rising shoulder of open ground. Prayer flags and gardens mark the south; the way round the massif's west is long and low, the way up the shoulder short and steep.

monastery_heights_walled.idea: A small walled garden on a slope below a few peaks, with a shaped pine at its heart, gaps north, south, east and west. The walls are low but they stop you: every way in is a door.

snowy_peaks_lake.idea: A frozen lake lying level in a hollow under a cluster of snowy peaks, snow slopes all round, ringed with snowy pines and ice rocks. The ice is wide open: quickest across, nothing to stand behind.

snowy_peaks_pass.idea: Stacked ice cliffs close in from both sides to a pass one cell wide at the middle, a frozen pond beyond it and snowy peaks below it. One gap: whoever holds it holds the map.

snowy_peaks_shelf.idea: A sheer shelf of stacked ice across the whole map, a cluster of peaks behind it. Gradual lifts of hex cells climb through it, each cell an ordinary move: two from the south, one from the north, so the shelf can be held or crossed at a few narrow places.

volcanic_peaks_crater.idea: A great cluster of cones with a crater in the middle of the map, a sheer basalt block on its west with stairs at either end and a lava fissure on its east. The fight goes round it.

volcanic_peaks_fissures.idea: Two lava fissures run in from the north corners and nearly meet at the middle of a dark slope. Three ways through: one narrow gap at the centre, the long ways round at each side. A cluster of cones with a crater stands to the south-east.

volcanic_peaks_ledge.idea: A wall of stacked basalt streaked with lava across the north, a sheer ledge under it with two stairs down, one lava fissure on the slant below. Small, close and hot.
